All values used on this site, as returned by the NAEP Data Service API. Use the buttons to copy or download the table.
The full cached extracts are also available as [`naep_tuda_ses.csv`](data/naep_tuda_ses.csv) (SES groups)
and [`naep_tuda_ses_points.csv`](data/naep_tuda_ses_points.csv) (SES index scores).

## SES groups

```{r}
naep_table()
```

## SES index scores

```{r}
naep_points_table()
```

Blank cells are estimates NAEP did not report because reporting standards were not met.
